prompt: From the 'challenges' collection in PocketBase, give me every challenge that is in category web or pwn, is dynamic, and has a score of at least 300 but under 550. Sort by score high to low, then by name A-Z. I want name, category, and score.
assertions: Uses one find_records call with a parenthesised OR group for the two categories combined via && with the other conditions
Expresses the score window as two comparisons (>= lower and < upper), not a single equality or a client-side filter
Every value in the filter is passed through filter_params placeholders, not interpolated into the template string
Uses a compound sort '-score,name' (descending score, then ascending name) via the sort parameter
Final answer is exactly the 7 gold rows in the gold order
is_dynamic filter is applied server-side (the result excludes El Dictador, which is web/500 but not dynamic)
